description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jarvan IV''' [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] all nearby enemies for 2 seconds.
description.text: Active: Jarvan IV slows all nearby enemies for 2 seconds.

description2.raw: '''Jarvan IV''' also grants himself a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for 4 seconds, increased by 1.3% of his '''maximum''' health for each enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] hit by ''Golden Aegis''.
description2.text: Jarvan IV also grants himself a shield for 4 seconds, increased by 1.3% of his maximum health for each enemy champion hit by Golden Aegis.

leveling2.raw:
'''Shield Strength:'''
60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 (+ 70% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * ''Golden Aegis'' deals no damage and thus does '''not''' trigger [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turret]] aggro, or effects such as [[File:Elixir of Sorcery item.png|20xpx|border|link=Elixir of Sorcery|An icon for the item Elixir of Sorcery]] [[Elixir of Sorcery]] and [[File:Sudden Impact rune.png|20xpx|link=Sudden Impact|An icon representing Sudden Impact]] [[Sudden Impact|Sudden Impact's]] activation. * ''Golden Aegis'' will activate [[combat status]] despite not dealing any damage.
notes.text:
Golden Aegis deals no damage and thus does not trigger turret aggro, or effects such as Elixir of Sorcery and Sudden Impact's activation.
Golden Aegis will activate combat status despite not dealing any damage.
